brand.name: ARPO
brand.positioning: Contabilidade como ferramenta estratégica de decisão

typography.font_family_sans: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif
typography.font_family_display: Segoe UI, Inter, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

images.approach: editorial, graphic and documentary; no generic corporate stock where avoidable

design_style.atmosphere: serious, organized, trustworthy, contemporary, executive, Brazilian boutique
design_style.personality: racional, próximo da liderança, técnico sem fricção, com autoridade editorial
design_style.formality: high-formality but warm enough to feel human
design_style.rhythm: editorial and measured, with distinct pauses between modules
design_style.composition: asymmetric blocks, layered information, restrained structure with clear visual hierarchy
design_style.space: generous negative space around statements and data blocks
design_style.text_image_relationship: text leads; imagery is secondary and architectural, not decorative
design_style.numbers: used as proof, not dashboard decoration
design_style.editorial_language: short sentences, precise claims and leadership-oriented framing
design_style.photography: none by default; when used, documentary and understated
design_style.institutional_presence: strong, but not grandiose; close to company strategy rather than institutional cliché

exclusive_signature.concept: a visual progression from operational complexity to decision clarity
exclusive_signature.expression: layered blocks, structured pathways, and a dark navy / orange contrast system that communicates organized knowledge and executive certainty
